projects.title: B1NBAGS
projects.subtitle: Personal clothing brand · Hong Kong
projects.shortDescription: A personal clothing brand started in Hong Kong in 2023.
projects.description: B1NBAGS is a brand I started in 2023 in Hong Kong, paused in 2024 to focus on university, and am restarting in 2025. Short teaser films, brand visuals and product photography. The banner pattern is built from scans of old Hong Kong dollar bills, edited in Photoshop. The Instagram carousel post was also assembled in Photoshop.

projects.title: Halatia
projects.subtitle: Brand identity · Eau de parfum · Paris
projects.shortDescription: Brand identity and art direction for Halatia Paris, a Parisian eau de parfum.
projects.description: Brand identity and art direction for Halatia Paris — a Parisian eau de parfum. The brand takes its name from halation, the photographic phenomenon of light spreading beyond its proper boundaries, used as a metaphor for a fragrance that leaves a radiant, invisible impression. The identity is built around an orange signature colour representing optimism, confidence, warmth and boundless energy, paired with a vintage film aesthetic drawn from Paris and classic photography. Designed for a new generation that defies labels.

projects.title: The Outfiters
projects.subtitle: Artistic direction · Vietnamese streetwear
projects.shortDescription: Artistic direction for a project selling Vietnamese streetwear to European markets.
projects.description: Artistic direction for a small project selling Vietnamese streetwear to European markets. The goal was to build an Instagram account that represented a mood board of the style and lifestyle we wanted to project to our audience — and within that mood board, mix in the Vietnamese brands to sell in Europe using the mood we had built up on the page.

projects.title: Ruinarktefact
projects.subtitle: Creative Director · ESSEC 2024/25
projects.shortDescription: Creative direction and head of communications for the Ruinarktefact campaign at ESSEC.
projects.description: Creative director and head of communications for RUINARKTEFACT, the year-long BDE campaign at ESSEC 2024/25 — two teams of 35 competing through events and communications. Directed rap videos, event aftermovies and teasers, plus a 20-minute declaration film for the campaign. Campaign identity, mascot, and Instagram managed entirely by Remi Karlin alongside a team of 5.

videos.title: Declaration Film
videos.description: Short film declaring all members of the campaign. Filmed on Sony FX3 with GM 24–70 · Edited in Premiere Pro and After Effects.

projects.campaignBody: Campaign-name designs were built across Illustrator, Photoshop, Procreate, Firefly and Midjourney. The mascot was designed and coloured in Procreate and Illustrator. The Instagram account was run by Remi Karlin alongside a team of 5, posting stories for events and promotional posts for the campaign.
